Hi, it's Rachel. Listen, I have an idea and I need an answer before Friday. If you come to Lisbon in October, I will take the whole week off. My flat is small, but if you do not mind the sofa, you will not spend a single euro on a hotel. If you book before the end of the month, the flights are still cheap. And if the weather is good, which it usually is in October, we will drive to the coast for two days. Give me a heads-up either way, otherwise I will keep asking you every week until you answer. Think about it.

Ana, it's Daniel. Bad news, but nothing dramatic. The client has cut the budget by twenty per cent, so we need a decision today. If we keep the same venue, we will have to drop the second stage. If we move to the smaller space, we will keep everything else and nobody will notice the difference. My honest opinion: if you approve the smaller venue this morning, I will have the new plan ready by six. If we wait until tomorrow, we lose the date. Call me when you have a minute.
